extraction.Name: Josephine Swallow, nee Brown
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment for the reason that she did not want to pay taxes; that she was told that she would have to accept it and pay taxes, and she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold her allotment to a McLaughlin, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $1150.00 cash
extraction.Buyer: a McLaughlin, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $1150.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: at the time she sold it, she paid up her taxes, amounting to $200.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband supports her and four minor children; her husband works in Chadron, Nebraska, for the Chicago & Northwestern Railroad Company—that being his only source of income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health not so very good, has liver trouble; husband's health is very good except for stomach trouble; children's health is good; sold allotment in March 1923; has never received any help from the County or Government; document subscribed and sworn before notary on November 16, 1928
